# HCSO Gives Award to Citizens Who Assisted Patrol Deputy

Deputy Jarod McCarty responded to an incident in the overnight hours that required assistance from citizens on the street where the incident occurred. We contacted them in the middle of the night to alert them to the situation and ensure they were safe. Without hesitation, Mary and Reid Bradford locked their doors and volunteered to set up all of the exterior lighting they could to help with visibility.

![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

After HCSO and other responding deputies cleared their barn, vehicles, and exterior of the home – the Bradfords came out on that cold morning with pecan pie cookies. This act of kindness and willingness to aid in the situation is something that has really stuck with Deputy McCarty and helped him through this difficult incident.

We salute the Bradfords and honor them with this Citizens Award. We are grateful for their kindness and service to HCSO, Deputy McCarty, and the entire community. #HCSO #PublicService #Community #Gratitude
